headline: Napoli vs Roma: near-even match, Roma narrow favourites
summary: Napoli host Roma in Serie A on Saturday afternoon, and the market sees a near-even match. Roma are the narrow favourites, with Napoli close behind at 34.4% and the draw the least likely result at 27.7%. Roma's win chance has slipped from 38.9% to 37.8% in recent days. Roma are rated only 0.07 goals better, so neither side gets a head start. Napoli are without centre-back Alessandro Buongiorno because of a knee problem. More than 2.5 goals is 50.9%, and both teams to score is 56.1% — more likely than not.
